排序顺序。取值如下：
- desc：降序。
- asc：升序。
description.en:
The sort order. Valid values:

- `desc`: descending.

- `asc`: ascending.

description.zh:
资源类型列表。取值如下：

- ECS：通用计算资源。
- Lingjun：灵骏智算资源。
description.en:
The resource type. Valid values:

- `ECS`: ECS.

- `Lingjun`: Lingjun intelligent computing resources.
Specifies whether to return all results.

description.en: The field to sort by. Valid values include: `DisplayName`, `GmtCreated`, `GmtModified`, `RegionID`, `Duration`, `PricingCycle`, and `PayType`.
The status of the resource group.

title.en: Obtain a List of Resource Groups

descriptions.zh: 目前，AI计算资源组（包括通用计算资源和灵骏智算资源）仅在部分地域提供服务。具体支持的地域列表，请参见[AI计算资源管理](~~143986~~)。
descriptions.en: Currently, AI computing resource groups (including ECS and Lingjun intelligent computing resources) are available only in specific regions. For a list of supported regions, see [AI computing resource management](~~143986~~).
